name: Indirect Tax Internship Scheme In Central Board Of Indirect Taxes And Customs (CBIC)
benefit:
> **Stipend** 1. The student interns will receive a stipend of ₹ 5,000/- per month for satisfactory conduct of the internship. 1. The graduate interns will receive a stipend of ₹ 15,000/- per month for satisfactory conduct of the internship.
> **Certificate** 1. On satisfactory completion of the internship, a Certificate of Internship shall be awarded. 1. Certificate of Internship would
_eligibility_text:
1. Law students who are pursuing a 3-year LLB course/5-year integrated LLB course. 1. Law graduates who have completed a 3-year LLB course/5-year integrated LLB course for not more than two years. 1. Students who have appeared in the final year/ semester examination on the cutoff date.
> **Reservation / Preference / Priority** Preference shall be given to students/graduates of reputed institutions.
